newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,496 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 3,496 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 3,496 contracts compared with 2,277 overnight Sunday.
There were 112 wheat, 1,589 corn, 1,249 soybean, 79 soymeal, 20 soyoil, two oat, 22 corn calls, 12 corn puts, 125 soybean calls and 286 soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-1/2 to 2-1/2 cents higher, corn was 1-1/2 to three cents higher and soybeans were 4-1/2 to 9-1/4 cents higher.
